*Lossy* is one long argument, but it is built out of about 140 separate ideas, and you do not have to meet them in order. Every idea has its own short page: one plain sentence, an example, a few paragraphs, and links to the ideas next to it. This page is the map of all of them.

The 13 themes below run in roughly the order of the argument, so reading down the page follows the story. Inside a theme, start anywhere. When an idea is worth the long version, its page points to where it is argued in full.

Prefer the story from the top? Take [[reading-path|the reading path]]: every chapter in order, each in a sentence or two. Short on time? [[the-short-version|The short version]] is the whole argument in a page.

## 1. How ideas travel

An idea reaches you through a chain of retellings, and two things happen at every link: it gets repackaged, and it gets filtered. [[how-ideas-travel|Open this theme →]]

## 7. Truths made by agreement
